name: 433. Vertex Gemini text-to-speech through generateContent: the Gemini body, usage, content blocks, undeliverable fields, truncated streams (vertex endpoint fixture) [SERIAL]
description: TXE-6540 regression, contract C3, C4, C5, C6, C10. Local fixture regression, no network traffic leaves the machine: run tests/e2e/api/runners/vertex-endpoint-fixture.mjs --app-dir <dir>, start an isolated gateway with -app-dir <dir>, and run with vertexEndpointFixture=1; every case is skipped otherwise. The rows cover every inbound route the change reaches: /v1/audio/speech buffered and streamed, the OpenAI drop-in speech route, and the native GenAI generateContent and streamGenerateContent addressed to vertex/. The fixture answers the models gemini-tts-ok, gemini-tts-blocked and gemini-tts-truncated on :generateContent and :streamGenerateContent in the generateContent shape; no Vertex TTS response has been recorded for these rows. Every row names the key with x-bf-api-key and reads back the requests that reached the fixture from /__connects, so it also pins one upstream call per request on the named key's region (none for a refused request). Before the change every vertex speech request was refused as an unsupported operation. Run the whole folder in order.

item.name: 433.1 vertex/gemini-tts-ok /v1/audio/speech stream_format sse with max_output_tokens: the Gemini body reaches :streamGenerateContent and speech.audio.done carries every usage detail, from one upstream call (vertex gemini speech)

exec: if (pm.variables.get('vertexEndpointFixture') !== '1') {
pm.execution.skipRequest();
} else {
pm.sendRequest({ url: 'http://127.0.0.1:8792/__reset', method: 'POST' }, function (err, res) {
pm.test('vertex gemini speech setup: the fixture was reset', function () { pm.expect(err, String(err)).to.equal(null); pm.expect(res.code).to.equal(200); });
var raw = pm.response.text() || '';
// vertexCalls: the model calls that reached the fixture standing in for Vertex, as they arrived.

function vertexCalls(cb) { pm.sendRequest({ url: 'http://127.0.0.1:8792/__connects', method: 'GET' }, function (err, res) { pm.test('the fixture answered /__connects', function () { pm.expect(err, String(err)).to.equal(null); pm.expect(res.code).to.equal(200); }); cb((res.json().data || []).reduce(function (all, c) { return all.concat(c.requests); }, []).filter(function (q) { return q.method === 'POST' && /:(generateContent|streamGenerateContent)/.test(q.path); })); }); }

pm.test('the client gets 200 with an SSE stream', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, raw).to.equal(200); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('content-type') || '', raw).to.include('text/event-stream'); });
var frames = raw.split(/\n\n/).map(function (f) { var m = /^data: (\{.*\})$/m.exec(f); return m ? JSON.parse(m[1]) : null; }).filter(Boolean);
var done = frames[frames.length - 1] || {};

pm.test('two audio deltas, then speech.audio.done as the final frame', function () { pm.expect(frames.map(function (f) { return f.type; }), raw).to.eql(['speech.audio.delta', 'speech.audio.delta', 'speech.audio.done']); });

pm.test('usage is the vendor\'s: output_tokens without the thought tokens, total_tokens with them', function () { pm.expect(done.usage, raw).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(done.usage.input_tokens, raw).to.equal(7); pm.expect(done.usage.output_tokens, raw).to.equal(50); pm.expect(done.usage.total_tokens, raw).to.equal(69); });

pm.test('usage.output_token_details carries candidatesTokensDetails and thoughtsTokenCount', function () { pm.expect(done.usage.output_token_details, raw).to.eql({ audio_tokens: 50, reasoning_tokens: 12 }); pm.expect(done.usage.input_token_details, raw).to.eql({ text_tokens: 7 }); });

vertexCalls(function (calls) { pm.test('exactly one upstream call, to the named key\'s region with its credentials', function () { pm.expect(calls, JSON.stringify(calls.map(function (c) { return c.host + c.path; }))).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(calls[0].host, calls[0].host).to.equal('us-central1-aiplatform.googleapis.com'); pm.expect(calls[0].path.split('?')[0], calls[0].path).to.equal('/v1/projects/fixture-project/locations/us-central1/publishers/google/models/gemini-tts-ok:streamGenerateContent'); pm.expect(calls[0].path, calls[0].path).to.include('key=REDACTED'); }); });

vertexCalls(function (calls) { pm.test('the body is the Gemini speech request: the bound as generationConfig.maxOutputTokens, audio modality, the voice', function () { var sent = JSON.parse(calls[0].body); pm.expect(sent.generationConfig.maxOutputTokens, calls[0].body).to.equal(1024); pm.expect(sent.generationConfig.responseModalities, calls[0].body).to.eql(['AUDIO']); pm.expect(calls[0].body, calls[0].body).to.match(/voiceName.{1,5}Kore/); pm.expect(sent.contents[0].parts[0].text, calls[0].body).to.equal('Say hello.'); pm.expect(sent.max_output_tokens, calls[0].body).to.equal(undefined); pm.expect(calls[0].path, calls[0].path).to.include('alt=sse'); }); });
